how_to_grow: Sow 3-4 seeds/pit at 2.5x1 m. Thin to 2 vines. Cut water during ripening for sweetness. Ripe when tendril near fruit dries; dull thump sound.
Sow 20 kg/ha at 60x20 cm. N in 3 splits — critical at knee-high & tasseling. Never miss irrigation at silking. Harvest when husks dry.

soil: Deep friable loam rich in humus
how_to_grow: Grow under 50% shade. Plant 2.5x2.5 m (Arabica). Blossom irrigation in March if rains fail. Pick only red-ripe cherries. Prune after harvest.
Plant 5x3 m. Choose one bahar (flower season) and stress-induce it. Drip irrigation ideal. Bag fruits against borer. Harvest at yellowish-red rind.
Plant 20 cm stem cuttings at 90x90 cm. Weed for first 3 months. Avoid waterlogging. Harvest tubers at 8-11 months.

soil: Rich loam with high organic matter
how_to_grow: Transplant 25-30 day seedlings at 45x45 cm. Apply borax 10 kg/ha to prevent hollow stem. Tie leaves to blanch curds. Harvest compact white curds.
Sow 100-120 kg pods/ha at 30x10 cm. Apply gypsum 250 kg/ha at flowering for pod fill. Earth up at pegging. Harvest when inner shell darkens.

season: Planted in winter (Dec-Jan); needs chilling hours
how_to_grow: Plant grafted saplings 6m apart. Needs cross-pollination — plant 2 varieties. Irrigate every 10 days in summer. Harvest when hulls split (Aug-Sep).

soil: Well-drained loam rich in organic matter
how_to_grow: Transplant 25-30 day seedlings 60x45 cm. Stake plants. Avoid overhead watering (blight). Calcium prevents blossom-end rot. Pick at breaker stage.
Sow with monsoon at 90x60 cm. Thin to 1 plant/hill. Monitor bollworm weekly with pheromone traps. Pick clean dry cotton in 3-4 rounds.
Train on pandal system at 3x3 m. Double pruning in India. Girdling + GA3 improves berry size. Harvest at 18-20 Brix sweetness.
Plant 8 m apart in 1 m pits with FYM. Apply 500g N, 320g P, 1200g K/palm/year. Irrigate 100 L/palm/week in summer. Bears from year 6-8.
Plant grafts 10x10 m. No irrigation during flowering. Spray 2% KNO3 to induce flowering. Bag fruits against fruit fly. Harvest with stalk.

soil: Loamy, rich in organic matter, well-drained
how_to_grow: Plant 1-year grafts in Jan-Feb at 3x3 m. Thin fruits to 1 per cluster. Harvest 130-135 days after bloom.
Sow 25-30 kg/ha at 30x10 cm. Fixes own nitrogen — only starter dose needed. Support climbing types. Pick tender pods every 3-4 days.
Sow 15-20 kg/ha at 30x10 cm. Treat seed with Rhizobium. Hoe at 25 days. Harvest when 80% pods blacken (70-90 days).

soil: Deep, rich loamy soil with good drainage
how_to_grow: Plant tissue-culture saplings 1.8x1.8 m. Apply 300g N, 100g P, 300g K per plant/year. Keep one sucker as follower. Bunch matures in 11-12 months.

soil: Clay or clay loam that holds water
how_to_grow: Transplant 25-30 day seedlings 20x15 cm. Keep 2-5 cm standing water. N in 3 splits. Drain 10 days before harvest at 80% golden grains.

soil: Sandy loam to loam, tolerates salinity
how_to_grow: Sow 100 kg seed/ha at 22 cm rows. 2-3 irrigations: crown root, flowering, grain fill. Harvest Mar-Apr.

soil: Friable sandy loam rich in humus
how_to_grow: Plant certified tubers 60x20 cm, 5 cm deep. Earth up at 25-30 days. Critical water at tuber initiation. Cut haulms 10 days before digging.
Plant 3-bud setts in 90 cm furrows. Earth up at 90-120 days against lodging. Trash mulch saves moisture. Harvest at peak sugar (~12 months).

season: Rabi main; Kharif in some regions
how_to_grow: Transplant 45-day seedlings at 15x10 cm. Light frequent irrigation (shallow roots). Stop water when 50% tops fall. Cure 3-5 days before storing.
Sow 100 kg/ha at 20-22 cm rows. First irrigation at 21 days (crown root) is most critical. Harvest at hard dough, ~12% moisture.
Plant 2-month seedlings at 1.8x1.8 m. Ring irrigation — water must not touch stem. Fruits from 9-10 months.
Transplant 4-week seedlings at 45x45 cm. Keep moisture steady to stop head splitting. Top-dress N at 30 days. Harvest firm heads.
Transplant 35-40 day seedlings at 60x45 cm. Mulch to hold moisture. Watch thrips & mites (leaf curl). Pick green or red-ripe for drying.

soil: Sandy loam rich in organic matter
how_to_grow: Sow 2-3 seeds/hill at 1.5x0.6 m. Trellis for straight fruits. Irrigate every 4-5 days. Pick tender fruits every 2 days.
Plant budded plants 6x6 m. Bahar treatment: withhold water 30-40 days to set flowering. Foliar spray Zn & Fe. Harvest at colour break.

soil: Fertile sandy loam with organic matter
how_to_grow: Transplant 30-day seedlings at 60x60 cm. Apply FYM 25 t/ha. Use pheromone traps for shoot & fruit borer. Pick glossy fruits.
